methods.weights: Grid-cell intersections with the California boundary in equal-area EPSG:3310. Fixed complete-data mask across all five fields and all months. Grid bounds inferred from coordinate midpoints.
methods.scope: California-wide grid-cell averages; not a forest-only mask. Coarse coastal cells retain their native model averages.
methods.burning: Monthly time-mean burntFractionAll in percent, including multiple fire classes. Never summed into unique annual burned area or a number of fires.
methods.carbon: Positive nbp is net transfer into land (plants and soil). Monthly mean kg C/m²/s multiplied by model-calendar seconds and 1000. Twelve monthly totals sum to annual g C/m²/year. cVeg is a separate stock in plants.
methods.periods: Twenty annual states per period; monthly calendar values average each calendar month over those years. Annual means of stored amounts and temperature are weighted by month lengths within each year.

spatial.interpolation: The website interpolates colors for display only. Selection, values and area-weighted distributions use these original model cells.
